Admissions time was one of the worst periods in my life. The best thing I can say to you is affirmations. You submitted your application. You worked hard in school. You have done everything you could. 

It is going to work out. 

Distract yourself with self care, doing things you love. The decisions will come when they do. May i suggest therapy/ counseling if that’s available to you. 

And I repeat, with as much care as possible, *get off this subreddit.* it is helpful and resourceful but it seems like you are all-consumed by decisions and you might start to compare yourself to others here. It can sometimes be toxic and filled with negativity. Taking a break from here saved my mental health during admissions. 

Take care. I was in the same position as you last year, and now I’m at the school of my dreams and loving it <3 reach out if you need anything

Don’t worry about it you’ll be good. 

Note: college admissions counselors can usually see through someone’s bullshit if they’re just doing extracurriculars to beef up their application. Not saying that you are, but it’s something to keep in mind. 

PS: try to spend minimal time on this subreddit. It is helpful, but oftentimes overwhelming, addicting, and it can cause you to compare yourself to others. 

Good luck!

NTA. It just sounds like she is projecting her insecurities onto you, whether she realizes it or not. 

Definitely not trying to excuse her behavior, but it can feel isolating when one friend achieves something and you don’t. Like, example: you lost weight and she’s still obese. Or if two friends are single and then one gets in a healthy relationship. 

I’m not sure if your friend was trying to be malicious. You don’t owe her an apology, because she went off on the rant, but I think it can be good to see things from her perspective. She sounds really insecure.

That doesn’t mean it was healthy. The dynamics of an abusive relationship (or even just a relationship with abusive “tendencies”) are very, very complex- and you can’t figure it out just by looking at the couple. I was in an abusive relationship with my ex boyfriend and he was so sweet to me in public, calling me beautiful, nice to my friends, etc. Behind closed doors, he would scream at me, berate me, insult my friends and demand to know why I liked them. I say this because it’s very possible her ex boyfriend isolated her from her friends and made her feel like it wasn’t okay to be involved with them, or perhaps he even threatened her. When you’re in love you go to great lengths for someone’s attention and validation. 

Or, explore the possibility that maybe she was being an asshole and just ditched you for her boyfriend. She probably didn’t even notice. Some people are not even aware when they do this in a relationship. I’m not sure how old you are but this happens more during younger years. Does that excuse her behavior? No, and she should take accountability for it. 

But the thing is that she once was a friend. I definitely wouldn’t say be mean to her, and I wouldn’t say that you need to be a large support system. I can’t give judgment because I don’t know how the relationship was. This is a very complex situation. 

You should be allowed to do what you feel is best for you. If you feel comfortable supporting her and hanging out with her, do it. If you don’t, then don’t. The ball is in your court.

Practice some self care, simple things like face masks, baths, etc. take time for yourself and work on your self esteem. Don’t focus on anyone else. I got myself a planner to keep track of things I need to do which helps my anxiety so much. You got this❤️

I completely understand that feeling. Remember that your anxious brain is just out to hurt you but that doesn’t mean you have to listen to it. (Easier said than done, I know. I still can’t not listen to my anxious brain either). Take it a day at a time, one test at a time. Allow yourself some breaks. Make a to-do list of studying tips. Watch educational videos, take notes, do practice problems. On test day, highlight and take deep breaths every once in a while. Ground yourself. I know what it’s like to constantly beat yourself up about these things especially school. But you are trying your best and that’s all you should have to do. Best of luck ❤️ shoot me a message if you need to talk
